direct_evidence: The Atomic run reports: The system cannot execute the specified program.
The Atomic run exits with code 1.
The selected capture exposes the scenario primarily as a gsecdump.exe -a process invocation and does not contain a direct credential-access event such as Sysmon Event 10.
residual_reviews.reason: A new hit would require a tool-name-specific gsecdump rule or another weak proxy despite the test execution itself failing. That would be calibration-score chasing rather than a tool-independent credential-access detector.
residual_reviews.reopen_condition: Revisit only if an independent capture provides a generic credential-access signal that does not depend on the gsecdump executable name.

direct_evidence: The Atomic prerequisite Computer must be domain joined is reported as failed.
The concrete Sysmon child process captured during P2-11I is mstsc.exe /v: with no remote target value.
The selected five-channel capture does not include TerminalServices operational telemetry proving a completed RDP session.
residual_reviews.reason: P2-11I benign-first review showed that an explicit-target mstsc /v:<target> rule is defensible, but the fixed scenario contains only a targetless /v: invocation. Expanding the rule to targetless mstsc solely to convert this scenario would weaken the detector.
residual_reviews.related_review: PR #129 closed unmerged as NO-GO / HOLD
residual_reviews.reopen_condition: Revisit only with a capture containing an explicit RDP target or direct session-establishment telemetry.

residual_reviews.description: Changing RDP Port to Non Standard Port via Powershell
direct_evidence: The Atomic execution succeeds while changing the RDP listener port and creating an inbound firewall rule.
The selected capture contains RDP service configuration activity but no RDP client or completed-session event.
residual_reviews.reason: The available telemetry proves configuration of an RDP service endpoint, not use of Remote Services: RDP. Mapping the configuration change itself to a T1021.001 scenario hit solely to improve the calibration score is not justified by the captured behavior.
residual_reviews.reopen_condition: Revisit only if project semantics explicitly redefine RDP endpoint configuration as sufficient T1021.001 evidence, or if a capture contains actual RDP use telemetry.

decision.note: The remaining three misses are retained rather than weakened into hits. P2-11K is an evidence-only closure review and does not change detector semantics, the rule tree, or the current P2-11J calibration result.
